requirement.description: The Flask hook implementation is incorrectly registering route functions, causing Flask to throw "View function mapping is overwriting an existing endpoint function: hook" errors. This happens because the hook is applied in a way that interferes with Flask's internal route registration mechanism, particularly when decorating functions with @app.route.
requirement.contract: Modify the Flask hook implementation to properly integrate with Flask's route registration without overwriting existing endpoint functions. The hook should wrap functions after Flask has processed the route decorator, preserving all Flask functionality while enabling debugging capabilities.
